name: varg-video-prompting
description: How to prompt varg's video, image, voice and music models so shots come out right on the first or second take: the working loop (references, look bible, environment master, character sheets, approved stills, audio lock, animate, QA), which model for which shot (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Veo 3.1, Wan 3, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5, ElevenLabs v4, Lyria, lip sync), prompt anatomy for video, stills and edits, what @image1, @video1 and @audio1 references copy, dialogue and voice rules, a frame and audio QA checklist, and gotchas from paid runs. Use when someone asks to "prompt Seedance", write a Kling or Veo prompt, pick a "varg video model" or asks "which model", does "image to video" or "video to video", needs a "consistent character" or location, makes "storyboard stills" or key frames, wants dialogue or lip sync, or asks why a clip looks like AI slop, drifted or ignored the prompt.
